notes.title: Remote Play Together is now supported!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42050162/ae4a8a6001e310ea4a1782a27070356ace1aa37c.png[/img][b]- Remote Play Together is now supported.[/b]
You can play "Jajamaru no Yokai Daisensen + Hell" with a friend via the Internet.
Even if your friend does not own the title, you can still play together.
For more information about Steam Remote Play, please visit the following link
https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay

[b]- Steam Cloud Save is now supported.[/b]
Saved data is automatically duplicated to the Steam server after the game is finished. If you access the game from a different computer, the files will be automatically downloaded to the new computer before the game starts.
You can also disable cloud synchronization from the title's properties in the Steam client.

We hope you continue to enjoy "Jajamaru no Yokai Daisensen + Hell"!

notes.title: Patch note 2.0.1.05
notes.content:
Patch note 2.0.1.05

 - The contents of Patch note 2.0.1.04 are also included.
 - Changed the image of the button for the operation explanation of the museum to the xbox controller. (Sorry, other controllers are not supported.)
 - Fixed a bug that the screen collapses while posing.
 - Fast-forwarding of the result is now 40x faster than 8x only when JaleCoin is maxed.
 - Language selection is now easier to find. (This is a somewhat aggressive solution, but...)
 - Fixed other minor bugs.
